author_note: User theory: v0 recall+verify helped, but novelty requires a MAKING component - mine HOW geniuses reason from worked solutions, compile that logic into weights, and construct answers for novel problems. This file freezes the protocol before any test-side evaluation.

mechanism.M_mine_genius_traces: from the 1000 solved gsm_train v1 problems (frozen indices of wspl-realbench-001), extract calculator annotations <<expr=result>> as ground-truth reasoning chains
C_compile_logic: skeleton head: fp64 closed-form ridge from frozen question embedding -> [count(+), count(-), count(*), count(/), n_steps]; NO gradients
word->constant logic table: mined (word, injected-constant) pairs from solution windows; compiled lookup, no gradients
mechanism.D_draft_making: for a novel problem: decode up to 3 operator skeletons from the compiled head, enumerate operand-grounded programs (text numbers + injected constants + intermediate results), execute ALL programs in one parallel pass (no autoregression anywhere)
mechanism.V_verify: internal only, no test labels: positive-integer rule, memory magnitude band from cosine 5-NN recalled answers (gsm_train memory), cross-draft consensus (count >= 2)
mechanism.A_answer: strict = consensus value, abstain counted wrong; loose = best-ranked valid draft (diagnostic)

data.train_memory: gsm_train v1 (1000 items, indices frozen in scripts/realbench/prereg.json, stage gsm_train)
test_tasks: HLE v1 T2 (56 integer-answer items, rule: gold parses as int)
excluded: GSM8K calc suite: excluded from Making (raw expressions contain the full program in the input text = oracle shortcut, not model reasoning); v0 recall numbers stand
MC tasks (ARC-C, MMLU): numeric grammar not applicable; v0 numbers stand

amendment_v1_1_before_any_test_eval.reason: train-side diagnostic (probe_train_enum.py, no test data): with GOLD skeletons, operand-coverage was 0.308 (n=561); word->constant table at support>=5/purity>=0.5/top40 compiled only 5 words; canonical ordering was NOT the bottleneck (gold median rank 6).

changes.word_constant_table: support >= 3, purity >= 0.4, top 60 by support (compiles 32 words on train)

amendment_v1_1_before_any_test_eval.measured_grammar_ceiling_disclosed: 1105/2940 non-text solution literals are story-specific facts not recoverable by any generalizable word->constant table (train-side count); this is an honest ceiling of the compiled grammar
amendment_v1_1_before_any_test_eval.status: amendment applied before ANY test-side evaluation

mining_rules.grammar: steps with exactly one operator, 1..4 steps; 561 head-train rows
mining_rules.word_constant_table: AMENDED v1.1: window = 60 chars of solution text before each annotation; tokens = lowercase [a-z]+; constants = step literals NOT present in question text; keep pairs with support >= 3 and purity >= 0.4 (constant = majority for that word); top 60 by support; at test inject <= 4 constants per problem

skeleton_head_recipe.estimator: ridge closed form (X^T X + lambda I)^{-1} X^T y, fp64, NO gradients
skeleton_head_recipe.standardization: mean/std from the 561 head-train rows, eps 1e-8
skeleton_head_recipe.lambda_selection: rng np.random.default_rng(20261123) shuffle of 561 rows, last 20% as val, val RMSE

decoding_rules.multisets: up to 3 distinct operator multisets: (a) rounded counts adjusted to n_steps; (b) one unit moved from lowest-predicted op to highest-predicted op; (c) top-n_steps ops one each; ranked a, b, c
decoding_rules.op_orders: all distinct permutations ranked by mined train-order prior (freq desc, then lexicographic)

operand_rules.text_numbers: regex \d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)? on question, strip commas, first 8 in text order
operand_rules.injected_constants: question lowercase tokens matched in word_constant_table, top-4 by support, deduped, appended after text numbers
operand_rules.consumption: each operand instance used at most once per program

enumeration_rules.cap: max 256 programs per problem, deterministic canonical order: skeleton rank -> op permutation rank -> operand pairs by pool index; from step 2 onward, pairs involving the previous result come first

verify_rules.integer_rule: |x - round(x)| < 1e-6 and x > 0 (train golds: 998/1000 positive integers)
verify_rules.memory_band: cosine 5-NN recalled gsm_train answers; valid band in(nn)/10, max(nn)*10]; out-of-band drafts demoted below in-band ones
verify_rules.consensus: value counts over valid drafts rounded to 1e-6; consensus = count >= 2; tie -> higher count, then first occurrence
verify_rules.loose: no consensus -> best-ranked valid draft (diagnostic only)

amendment_v1_2_before_any_test_eval.reason: val-side check of the count-regression skeleton head: gold-multiset recall only 0.027 (n=112). Replaced (supersede, not tuned on test) by MC-style compiled classifier + skeleton recall, both closed-form/gradient-free.
amendment_v1_2_before_any_test_eval.skeleton_drafts_recipe: union of (a) ridge one-hot classifier over top-24 most frequent ordered skeleton classes (closed-form fp64, lambda grid selected on train-val by top-3 exact-class accuracy; selected lambda=100) -> top-3 predicted classes; (b) kNN-5 over the 561 skeleton-bearing train rows (cosine, standardized) -> each neighbor's skeleton; dedupe by multiset; class-rank order; max 8 multisets
amendment_v1_2_before_any_test_eval.draft_cap_amended: per op-order cap 128, global cap 1024 (bounded runtime, spreads coverage across op orders)
amendment_v1_2_before_any_test_eval.two_recall_memories_disclosed: skeleton recall uses the 561 skeleton-bearing rows; answer-band recall uses the 1000-item answer memory (v0-style)
amendment_v1_2_before_any_test_eval.status: amendment applied before ANY test-side evaluation

metrics_and_comparison.success_criterion_frozen: acc_strict on GSM8K full > 2x recall baseline (i.e. > 2.2%) means Making adds capability beyond memory; otherwise report as honest negative

run_integrity.operand_grounding_disclosure: operands come from input question tokens (available to any model through its encoder) and mined train constants; the REASONING (operators, order) is predicted by compiled weights from the embedding
run_integrity.mc_and_calc: unchanged from v0; only numeric novelty tasks evaluated here
